art_form_description: 120–220 word workplace scene or decision moment that forces opinion. Not a textbook explainer. Show people choosing, reacting, or failing with data/visuals — do not lecture definitions.
banned_phrases: at the end of the day

channel_discipline.student_content: task prompts and questions only — never ceremony, agenda maps, or minute-by-minute facilitation
channel_discipline.teacher_notes: short procedure bullets only — grouping, timing cues, what to monitor — not a spoken host script
